ChrisStock: what I built

A one-minute tour of the stock forecasting project: why Taiwan, the pipeline, news sentiment, four models and how they train, the website, and the person behind it.

0:00 / 0:00

The music and sound effects are generated live in your browser and are included in the saved video, and so is the woman's voice in five chapters. The optional full Narration uses your browser's built-in voice and isn't included in the saved file. Saving records the video in real time, so it takes the full 1:03, and the tab has to stay visible while it records. The saved .mp4 plays almost anywhere: phones, PowerPoint, LINE, YouTube. (Older browsers that can't record MP4 save a .webm instead.)
